feasibility: A new restricted in-memory Git adapter is technically possible; the existing REST transport/dependencies do not implement it. Provider authentication/capability compatibility and bounded parser acceptance remain unproven.
eligibility: End of sale since 2024-06-17; organizations that used CSR before that date retain access. New unaffiliated projects cannot enable it. Current migration guidance anticipates shutdown with at least one year notice; no shutdown date is asserted here.

content.api_distinction: Google documents cloning. Git smart-HTTP negotiation comes from the Git specification, not the sourcerepo discovery contract. Repo.url is a clone locator, not file content.
not_established: CSR support for partial-clone filters, protocol v2, or arbitrary immutable SHA wants
Helper-free use of the current REST Bearer header on the Git host
A provider selected-file REST, raw-file, archive, or Gitiles content endpoint

current_implementation: gcp.py source_repositories() lists Repo metadata and hydrates IAM; no content collection or selected-file Git kind is registered.

Transport.request accepts allowlisted googleapis.com hosts and explicitly bound read POST routes, sends JSON, parses JSON, and caches projected metadata. It rejects source.developers.google.com and Git upload-pack POST.
pyproject.toml and requirements.txt declare requests/google-auth but no Dulwich, pygit2/libgit2, or GitPython. No existing bounded Git object decoder was found in the reviewed collector/scanner path.
Dataform selected-file transport is a useful in-memory streaming/projection pattern but calls a different native REST API; it cannot read CSR files.
secret_scanning.scan_content supports in-memory Kingfisher and TruffleHog stdin with offline redaction; a Git adapter must preserve that boundary.

proposed_minimal_adapter.admission: Opt-in content_secret_scans plus a dedicated explicit surface selection; exact canonical project/repository, full 40-hex SHA-1 commit, and 1..8 normalized relative file paths. Reject branches/tags, URLs, traversal, encoded separators, duplicate selectors and scope mismatches before credentials.
proposed_minimal_adapter.authentication_gate: Establish an official helper-free HTTPS credential contract for the selected native identity before admission. Do not infer Git authentication from the REST OAuth scope; do not execute gcloud, credential helpers, configure-git scripts, SSH agents or ambient credentials in this adapter.
proposed_minimal_adapter.network: Dedicated streamed binary transport, no generic host/POST allowlist expansion. Exact source.developers.google.com:443 and constructed /p/{project}/r/{repo} routes only; no redirects, proxy inheritance, netrc, cookies, alternate hosts, mirrors, dumb-HTTP fallbacks or receive-pack. Validate Repo.name and clone locator against the selected canonical project/repo; never follow Repo.url blindly.
proposed_minimal_adapter.negotiation: Start with a small explicitly supported smart-HTTP version/capability set. Require the exact selected commit to be advertised; older unadvertised commits remain unsupported in the minimal version. Never substitute a moving ref. Do not assume filter/shallow support; absent capabilities must fail or use only the same bounded full-pack read, never an unbounded fallback.
proposed_minimal_adapter.parser: Separate reviewed in-memory decoder or audited pinned library with limits applied before allocation/inflate. Minimal version accepts self-contained PACK v2 undeltified commit/tree/blob only; reject OFS_DELTA, REF_DELTA, thin packs, tags, unknown object types, alternate object stores and extra pack/trailer data. Rejecting deltas deliberately limits compatibility; receiving a normal deltified repository is incomplete, never clean.
proposed_minimal_adapter.binding: Validate framing, object count, zlib termination, declared/actual sizes, pack checksum and canonical Git object hashes. Match the selected commit hash, traverse its tree by exact path bytes, and bind the final blob hash/mode. Never scan objects from another commit; reject symlink 120000, gitlink 160000 and nonregular selected entries. Do not evaluate .gitattributes, hooks, filters, .gitmodules or LFS; selected LFS pointers remain unsupported content, without dereferencing.
proposed_minimal_adapter.privacy: No clone, fetch subprocess, checkout, temporary pack, object database or code files on disk. In-memory buffers only; scanner receives selected text blobs under opaque selector IDs. Persist only redacted findings, static reasons, counts and opaque provenance; never raw ref names, paths, URLs with selectors, commit messages, pack data, stderr, credentials or code in evidence/cache/logs. Selected-file scanning does not imply selected-file-only transfer: Git may deliver unrelated blobs, which must be bounded and discarded.
proposed_minimal_adapter.budget_rules: Enforce counters across every object, including unselected data and intermediate buffers; check deadline/cancellation during framing, inflation, traversal and scanner waits. Reject oversize varints before allocation and use capped inflate output, with an isolated decoder memory ceiling. Any limit, unsupported mode/capability, auth failure, malformed response or scanner failure yields incomplete/unknown; zero findings requires complete selected content and both detectors.
implementation_order: Resolve authentication/capability contract and select a reviewed decoder approach; otherwise retain unsupported.
Build isolated binary transport and bounded decoder with offline adversarial fixtures; no network in acceptance tests.
Add content-only planner/collector/check integration and redacted cross-surface dedup only after transport/parser gates pass.
offline_acceptance: Recorded/synthetic smart-HTTP success binds exact commit/tree/path/blob and runs pinned offline detectors on selected bytes only.
Reject moving/unadvertised SHA, ref change, cross-project Repo.url, redirect, userinfo, encoded traversal, unexpected POST and alternate host before credentials or follow-up I/O.

Reject truncated/oversized pkt-lines, sideband errors/progress leaks, checksum/hash mismatch, invalid varints/zlib, excess objects/expansion/tree depth, deltas/thin packs, missing blob and unsupported LFS/symlink/submodule.

Prove byte/RSS/time/call ceilings on compressed bombs and cancellation, zero raw disk writes, zero helper/hook/filter/submodule/LFS execution, no ambient auth/proxy, and no plaintext in logs/cache/evidence/errors.
Exercise missing/failed scanner and partial transport cases as incomplete; successful zero-findings applies only to explicitly selected files, not repository coverage.

auth_followup.contract: Google-owned archived helper supplies Basic username git-service-account and existing OAuth2 access token as password. No helper is executed by the app.
auth_followup.limit: Historical primary implementation evidence; current provider compatibility and end-to-end content inspection remain unverified.

primitive_followup.transport: fixed-host bounded smart HTTP, Basic OAuth2 mapping, exact advertised commit only; no thin/side-band negotiation
primitive_followup.decoder: PACK2/3, self-contained OFS/REF deltas, exact selected commit/tree/blob binding, deadlines and aggregate bounds
remaining: Native project/repository authority adapter and independent consumer proof
Explicit public selection, catalog admission and collector/check integration
Installed native API/HTTP/scanner engine acceptance; no live CSR authentication claim
primitive_followup.memory_limit: Logical payload/expansion accounting; no process RSS ceiling asserted.
